method: Guide and quiz ranking: 60% best study-guide similarity, 25% direct quiz coverage weighted by existing question priority, 15% direct essentials reference. Preserve previous red markers and the lecture top-40% baseline; add reviewed slide anchors for every substantive study-guide topic, all five assigned articles, and non-memory labs represented in the question bank.
interpretation: Must know identifies core review priorities. Scores are not probabilities of appearing on the exam.
source_material: Supplied Exam 1 study guide, lecture scripts, 208-question bank, essentials guide, and existing guide-weighted question priorities using six supplied example questions. No external exam dataset.
